card.fact_statement: The song "Ah! ca ira!" was performed during the Liberté sequence of the 2024 Summer Olympics opening ceremony.
card.source_span: In one of its windows, a beheaded Marie Antoinette (who was imprisoned at the site before eventually being guillotined) sang the opening notes of Ah! ca ira!, joined by heavy metal band Gojira

target_qa_variants.translation_note: Translated 'Liberté sequence' to '“自由”篇章'. The French song title 'Ah! ca ira!' is kept as it is standardly used as a proper noun in Chinese media for this performance.
